data.gender_notes: Ermeena is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ermeena is derived from the Greek word 'eremon', meaning 'to toil' or 'to labor'. In Greek mythology, Ermeenos was a god of labor and fertility. This name embodies the strength, resilience, and determination of those who work hard and overcome challenges. The name Ermeena carries the meaning “Strong, toil, labor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ermeena usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, toil, labor and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: ארמינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'aram' which means 'high, exalted, mighty' and the suffix 'na' which means 'grace, favor, or gift'. Thus, Ermeena means 'Strong, powerful one with favor or grace.'

in_greek.name: Ερμεήνη
in_greek.long_meaning: In Greek, Ermeena is a variant of the Greek name Hermione. Hermione is derived from the Greek word 'herma' which means 'god' and 'ion' which means 'son'. Thus, Hermione means 'God's son'. Ermeena could be a variant of Hermione, meaning 'God's powerful one'.

in_latin.name: Ermeena
in_latin.long_meaning: In Latin, Ermeena is a variant of the Latin name Hermina. Hermina is derived from the Latin word 'herm' which means 'army' and the suffix 'ina' which means 'belonging to'. Thus, Hermina means 'belonging to the army'. Ermeena could be a variant of Hermina, meaning 'Strong, powerful one belonging to the army'.

in_english.name: Ermeena
in_english.long_meaning: Ermeena is a name of Hebrew origin, meaning 'Strong, powerful one with favor or grace'. It is derived from the Hebrew word 'aram' which means 'high, exalted, mighty' and the suffix 'na' which means 'grace, favor, or gift'.
